text:
Zoe: Quick UX bug: when the small toast shows up while opening the project settings modal, the toolbar content shifts down ~10px. Seen on Chrome and Safari. Screenshot: https://placeholder.img/toolbar-shift.png
Miguel: yep repro. Toast is in document flow so it pushes things.
Hana: that causes focus to move for keyboard users when modal opens. a11y risk.
Zoe: suggestion: move toasts into a fixed layer below modals, animate with transform, and make them aria-live regions so screen readers still announce them.
Miguel: CSS idea:
```css
.toast { position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px); transition: transform .16s, opacity .12s; pointer-events: none; }
.modal { z-index: 1200; }
```
Priyanka: pointer-events none by default is good. ensure hover still works (pointer-events: auto on :hover). also add aria-hidden when hiding.
Hana: focus ring on icon-only toolbar buttons is way too subtle. Recommend 2px focus outline using --color-focus and outline-offset: 2px. Also audit all icon buttons for aria-labels.
Zoe: microcopy note: toasts say "Saved" in some places and "Changes saved" in others. prefer "Changes saved" for consistency.
Miguel: rather than changing global spacing tokens, add a component token --toolbar-gap (8px) and use it in toolbar. less risk.
Priyanka: QA plan: e2e that opens modal while a toast is triggered and asserts document.activeElement is modal close button and header y-pos difference < 6px.
Hana: will run VoiceOver and NVDA checks once PR lands.
design-bot: PR opened: redwood/design-system#678 — "toasts: fixed layer; toolbar gap token; focus + a11y fixes" (assigned to Priyanka)
Zoe: thanks! Please tag platform-ux for visibility. :thumbsup:
